citations.quote:
[name="莫斯提马"]……薇尔丽芙不在呢。
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]门掩着，应该只是走开一下，等等就好了。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_213_mostma_1#10$2",focus="r")]
[name="莫斯提马"]如果擅自搜查薇尔丽芙的办公室……哇哦，感觉会死。
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]薇尔丽芙不想被人看见的东西，你以为在这里转五分钟就能搜出来？
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_213_mostma_1#10$2",focus="r")]
[name="莫斯提马"]就算搜不出什么，做这件事就足以被她杀掉了吧？而且，要是奥伦偷偷把情书放在了她办公室，又不告诉她……
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#8$1",focus="l")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]我求求你了。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_213_mostma_1#11$2",focus="r")]
[name="莫斯提马"]好冷漠啊，菲亚梅塔。
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]……难道你真干过？
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_213_mostma_1#10$2",focus="r")]
[name="莫斯提马"]呵呵，怎么可能。要是发生过那种事，奥伦的墓碑今年也该这么高了。
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]……能别把墓碑说得像生长期的小孩一样吗？
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_213_mostma_1#10$2",focus="r")]
[name="莫斯提马"]说真的，真正搜查过薇尔丽芙办公室的不是你吗，菲亚梅塔侦探？
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]菲亚梅塔侦探没那么大本事，谢谢。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_213_mostma_1#4$2",focus="r")]
[name="莫斯提马"]咦，薇尔丽芙从那一天之后就再没在明面上给我们的队长穿小鞋，难道不是你们在她这里找伞的时候发现了她的把柄？
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]……你要是好奇，就直接问，不要在你的想象里发挥创作欲。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_213_mostma_1#10$2",focus="r")]
[name="莫斯提马"]好啊。那你们在薇尔丽芙的办公室，究竟找到了什么？

[name="薇尔丽芙"]安多恩，菲亚梅塔，现在不是你们的执勤时间，你们在七厅办公区域蹑手蹑脚、东张西望，有什么企图？
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_1800_1#1$3",focus="l")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]你在说什么，薇尔丽芙？我们只是来找落下的东西，莫斯提马说……
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_361_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="薇尔丽芙"]你们“队长”在场，现在不由你发言，菲亚梅塔。
[name="薇尔丽芙"]回答我，安多恩。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_1800_1#1$3",focus="r")]
[name="安多恩"]如菲亚梅塔所言，我们来找莫斯提马可能遗落在这里的雨伞，薇尔丽芙辅佐官。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_361_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="薇尔丽芙"]你是莫斯提马的保姆吗？
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_1800_1#6$3",focus="r")]
[name="安多恩"]我是她的队长。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_361_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="薇尔丽芙"]队长的职责就是跟在她屁股后面捡东西，再在报告中欺瞒上峰？
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_1800_1#1$3",focus="r")]
[name="安多恩"]我不认为发生过你所指控的事。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_361_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="薇尔丽芙"]注意你的态度。如果你无法胜任特勤小队队长的工作——
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#6$1",focus="l")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_1800_1#1$3",focus="l")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]够了，薇尔丽芙！
[name="菲亚梅塔"]纯找茬啊你！你又不是我们上司，什么欺瞒上峰！
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_361_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="薇尔丽芙"]特勤小队所执行任务中与七厅事务相关的行动报告，我有权调阅——

[name="菲亚梅塔"]……
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_213_mostma_1#7$1",focus="r")]
[name="莫斯提马"]这片屋顶修补好之后，其实还蛮适合看风景的，对吧。我有点喜欢上这里了。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_213_mostma_1#10$1",focus="r")]
[name="莫斯提马"]其实三年前我就以为是结束了，可惜世事莫测。好在也没有晚太多。
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]莫斯提马。薇尔丽芙说，你之后不再做万国信使了，只挂名，不接任务。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_213_mostma_1#10$1",focus="r")]
[name="莫斯提马"]其实还没有完全敲定来着……
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#4$1",focus="l")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]因为我吗？
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_213_mostma_1#7$1",focus="r")]
[name="莫斯提马"]……不，当然不是了。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_213_mostma_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="莫斯提马"]因为拉特兰的隐秘不再隐秘，由堕天使来行使万国信使职能的风险已经不同于以往。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_213_mostma_1#7$1",focus="r")]
[name="莫斯提马"]安多恩已经被流放，更重要的是，他不会、也不需要再追寻锁匙中的秘密。他从律法本身得到了答案——还稍微多做了一点。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_213_mostma_1#2$1",focus="r")]
[name="莫斯提马"]伊万杰利斯塔十一世为保护律法隐秘所做的布置已经完成了使命，这十年以来，我真正的工作……已经结束了。

[name="薇尔丽芙"]你决定了？
[character(name="avg_npc_353_1#1$2")]
[name="蕾缪安"]嗯，我决定了。
[character(name="avg_npc_361_1#1$1")]
[name="薇尔丽芙"]我以为你还要犹豫一段时间。
[character(name="avg_npc_353_1#2$2")]
[name="蕾缪安"]没什么……只是觉得，大家都迈出了下一步，我也不能再原地踏步了。
[character(name="avg_npc_361_1#6$1")]
[name="薇尔丽芙"]那我就不多问了。你能答应，我已经很高兴了。
[character(name="avg_npc_361_1#6$1")]
[name="薇尔丽芙"]现在这种时候，有你这样的人才加入，再好不过。
[dialog]
[character]
[playsound(key="$d_gen_walk_n")]
[character(name="avg_4036_forcer_1#1$1",fadetime=1,block=true)]
[delay(time=2)]
[character]
[playsound(key="$d_gen_walk_n")]
[character(name="avg_213_mostma_1#10$1",name2="avg_300_phenxi_1#1$1",fadetime=1,block=true)]
[delay(time=3)]
[character(name="avg_213_mostma_1#10$1")]
[name="莫斯提马"]就猜到你会在这里，薇尔丽芙。
[character(name="avg_npc_361_1#4$1")]
[name="薇尔丽芙"]你们怎么……
[character(name="avg_300_phenxi_1#1$1")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]我们半路遇到了艾泽尔。
[character(name="avg_4036_forcer_1#1$1")]
[name="艾泽尔"]谢拉格的两位使者已经送达目的地了。
[character(name="avg_npc_361_1#6$1")]
[name="薇尔丽芙"]辛苦了。
[character(name="avg_npc_361_1#6$1")]
[name="薇尔丽芙"]别急着走，我来这里还有别的事，你跟我一起。
[character(name="avg_4036_forcer_1#1$1")]
[name="艾泽尔"]……是。
[character(name="avg_npc_361_1#5$1")]
[name="薇尔丽芙"]那么，蕾缪安，下周见。
[character(name="avg_npc_353_1#9$2")]
[name="蕾缪安"]下周见。

citations.quote:
[name="能天使"]本来想过段时间给你们一个惊喜的，这不是……嘿嘿。
[name="能天使"]（试图挠头）
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#9$1",focus="r")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_213_mostma_1#12$1",focus="r")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]蕾缪安，怎么回事？
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_1041_angel2_1#5$1",focus="r")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_1811_1#11$2",focus="r")]
[name="蕾缪安"]……一两句话说不清楚。
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#9$1",focus="r")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_213_mostma_1#7$1",focus="r")]
[name="莫斯提马"]要不，我帮你争取两分钟逃跑？
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_1041_angel2_1#9$1",focus="l")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_1811_1#11$2",focus="l")]
[Delay(time=2)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_1041_angel2_1#3$1",focus="l")]
[multiline(name="能天使")]也行——
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_1041_angel2_1#9$1",focus="l")]
[multiline(name="能天使",end=true)]还是别给我老姐添乱了，下次吧！
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_1811_1#1$2",focus="r")]
[name="蕾缪安"]……
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[playsound(key="$d_gen_walk_n",volume=1)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1780_1#1$1",duration=1.5)]
[Delay(time=2)]
[name="薇尔丽芙"]抱歉，我是不是打扰你们几位好友团聚了？
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_1041_angel2_1#1$1",focus="all")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_1811_1#8$2",focus="all")]
[Delay(time=2)]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_1811_1#8$2",focus="r")]
[name="蕾缪安"]前辈。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1780_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="薇尔丽芙"]蕾缪安枢机，你自己一个人就能够将嫌犯带回第七厅吗？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1780_1#3$1",focus="m")]
[name="薇尔丽芙"]还是说，需要支援……？毕竟试图破坏育婴圣堂，干涉万国峰会，可是干系重大！
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_1041_angel2_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_1811_1#2$2",focus="r")]
[name="蕾缪安"]不放心的话，前辈你可以和我一起，或者让铳骑监督。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1780_1#3$1",focus="m")]
[name="薇尔丽芙"]别这么说话嘛。毕竟根据阿摩斯辅佐官的证词，你确实之前就在其他案发现场发现了蕾缪乐的踪迹……
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_1041_angel2_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_1811_1#5$2",focus="r")]
[name="蕾缪安"]你是想说，我试图包庇自己的妹妹？
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1780_1#8$1",focus="m")]
[name="薇尔丽芙"]那倒是没有，毕竟都是间接证据，不足以说明你采取了什么行动。
[name="薇尔丽芙"]还记得我们之前在圣堂内的谈话吗？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1780_1#9$1",focus="m")]
[name="薇尔丽芙"]我很欣赏你的能力和办事手段，“噤声的蕾缪安”，不过我也清楚你那些美好的品质一般在什么时候最能得到体现……
[name="薇尔丽芙"]更何况这次牵涉到的是你的妹妹，我们有所怀疑也是在所难免，请你理解。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_1041_angel2_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_1811_1#2$2",focus="r")]
[name="蕾缪安"]那你们大可放心。放小乐背着一身罪名乱跑，并不能真正帮到她。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1780_1#8$1",focus="m")]
[name="薇尔丽芙"]嗯嗯，只要蕾缪乐能够配合，我相信这里面的误会一定能解开的。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_1041_angel2_1#1$1",focus="all")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_1811_1#8$2",focus="all")]
[Delay(time=0.5)]
[playsound(key="$d_gen_walk_n",volume=1)]
[charslot(slot="l",afrom=1,ato=0,duration=1)]
[charslot(slot="l",posfrom="0,0",posto="-200,0",duration=1.5)]
[charslot(slot="r",afrom=1,ato=0,duration=1)]
[charslot(slot="r",posfrom="0,0",posto="-200,0",duration=1.5)]
[Delay(time=2.5)]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#1$1",focus="all")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_213_mostma_1#10$1",focus="all")]
[Delay(time=0.5)]
[charslot(slot="r",posfrom="0,0",posto="-100,0",duration=1.5)]
[charslot(slot="l",posfrom="0,0",posto="-100,0",duration=1.5)]
[Delay(time=1.5)]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_213_mostma_1#10$1",focus="none")]
[name="薇尔丽芙"]稍微等等，“微光守夜人”，还有……万国信使莫斯提马。
[Dialog]
[charslot(slot="r",posfrom="-100,0",posto="0,0",duration=1.5)]
[charslot(slot="l",posfrom="-100,0",posto="0,0",duration=1.5)]
[Delay(time=1.5)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_213_mostma_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="莫斯提马"]……
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]怎么了？
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1780_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="薇尔丽芙"]两位请暂时留在育婴圣堂，教皇厅有些任务需要交给两位。
